Position: Frontend Developer

Company Overview
Luminary Cloudworks is a fast-growing SaaS provider delivering modular business applications for mid-market enterprises. Our platform emphasizes component-driven design, high-performance delivery, and strong developer ergonomics. We work with distributed teams across India to build scalable customer-facing applications and internal developer tools. We are seeking an experienced Frontend Developer to join our product engineering team and drive the implementation of rich, performant user interfaces built on modern Vue.js tooling.

Position Summary
As a Frontend Developer at Luminary Cloudworks you will be responsible for designing and implementing frontend components and pages for our flagship product suite. You will collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, backend engineers and QA to ship features that are accessible, maintainable and performant. You should be comfortable translating wireframes into production-ready code, optimizing rendering and load performance, and contributing to frontend architecture and best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Feature Development and Implementation
- Translate UI/UX designs and requirements into responsive, accessible frontend components using Vue.js and Nuxt.js.
- Implement pages, layouts and reusable components using HTML and CSS, ensuring cross-browser compatibility and adherence to design system guidelines.
- Integrate with backend APIs to fetch and present data, handle optimistic updates, and manage error states.

Architecture, Reuse and Component Design
- Design and implement a scalable component library and page patterns to promote reuse across multiple product modules.
- Author clean, well-documented components with clear public APIs and props to support product teams building on top of the platform.
- Drive decisions around directory structure, state management patterns and component communication strategies.

Performance, Quality and Maintainability
- Optimize client-side rendering, lazy-load routes and assets, and minimize bundle size to ensure fast initial load and snappy runtime performance.
- Write unit and integration tests for frontend components, and collaborate on automated end-to-end testing strategies.
- Conduct regular code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and enforce frontend engineering best practices.

Collaboration and Delivery
- Work in an Agile environment, participate in sprint planning, grooming and demos, and own feature delivery for assigned epics.
- Collaborate with designers to refine interactions, accessibility experts to meet WCAG guidelines, and backend teams to define stable API contracts.
- Triage and resolve production issues, participate in on-call rotations for frontend incidents as needed.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 2-5 years

Technical Skills (Required / Mandatory)
- Vue.js
- HTML
- Nuxt.js
- CSS

Other Qualifications
- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a distributed team.
- Experience translating design assets into pixel-accurate, responsive UIs.
- Familiarity with RESTful APIs and asynchronous data fetching patterns.
- Good communication skills for cross-functional collaboration in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- Vite
- TypeScript
- JavaScript
- Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library.
- Prior experience working in SaaS or enterprise web applications.

Location and Work Mode
- Fully remote within India.

Success Metrics
- Timely delivery of committed features with high quality (on-time sprint completion rate and low bug reopen rate).
- Component reuse rate and reduction in duplicated UI code across product modules.
- Measurable improvements in frontend performance metrics (time-to-interactive, bundle size reduction).
- Customer and product team satisfaction with UI quality, accessibility and responsiveness.
- Contribution to team knowledge: number of code reviews, mentorship interactions and internal documentation authored.
